newsitem.title: POLAND: Relpol sees higher 1997 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Relpol sees higher 1997 net profit.

text.p: Polish electromagnetic transmitter producer Relpol SA expects to lift group net profit to about 10 million zlotys from 5.5 million zlotys in 1996, the firm's president told the daily Parkiet in its Friday edition.
"This year consolidated net profit should amount to about 10 million zlotys," Krzysztof Prucnal was quoted as saying.
Prucnal reiterated his firm's expectation to lift parent net to about six million zlotys from 5.3 million last year.
The firm has made a group net profit of 4.6 million zlotys in the first five months of this year and 2.8 million parent. @
Prucnal told the paper that his firm planned no new issues this year but was considering a convertible bond issue.
He said the firm planned to move production of some of its tranmitters east of the Polish border but that no definite decision had been made.
Prucnal also said Relpol would concentrate on the production of cash registers and electric equipment for the automotive industry.
